project_type: Harbor Terminal-Bench debugging task - multi-tier cache eviction engine
build_system: stdlib-only Python with uv for test runner
test_framework: pytest with 10 graduated tests in 3 tiers (easy/medium/hard)
verification_instructions: Run the cache engine, then run pytest to verify 10 tests pass. Easy tests pass with bugs, medium need 1-2 fixes, hard need 3-4 fixes.
setup_instructions: This is a greenfield task creation - no dependencies to install
environment_constraints: Task runs inside Docker container. Files are at /app/runtime/ in container. Tests at /tests/. Solution at /solution/.
contribution_requirements: Must match the exact structural pattern of the approved scheduler-engine-repair task. 4 bugs, 10 tests, same file layout.
key_patterns: ConfigParser-based config with multiple sections, dataclass models, modular processing pipeline, deterministic JSON output, string replacement repair script
directory_structure: environment/ (Dockerfile + runtime/), tests/ (test.sh + test_cache.py), solution/ (solve.sh + repair_cache.py), instruction.md, task.toml
